newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CBA buys TNT car management.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CBA buys TNT car management.

text.p: The Commonwealth Bank of Australia said on Thursday it had further developed its position in the motor vehicle operating lease market by acquiring the external fleet management business of TNT Fleet Management, a subsidiary of TNT Ltd. No price was disclosed.

"TNT has a number of significant fleet management contracts and considerable experience and expertise in the management of government fleets," the bank said. TNT is subject to an agreed A$2 billion takeover bid by Dutch telecom and postal group Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV.
"TNT has a number of significant government fleet management contracts and considerable experience and expertise in the management of government fleets," Commonwealth Bank said.
"With the acquisition of these assets, the Commonwealth Bank has complemented its already very strong position as a provider of fleet leasing packages to government clients," it said.
The bank said that during the past six months, it had been successful in obtaining more than half a billion dollars of government fleet lease business.
